scripts.dev:staging: if [ ! -f ../../.env.staging.local ]; then echo 'Missing .env.staging.local.'; exit 1; fi; wrangler dev --env staging --env-file ../../.env.staging.local
scripts.dev:production: if [ "$ALLOW_PRODUCTION_DEBUG" != "true" ]; then echo 'Refusing to connect the local API to production.'; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -f ../../.env.production.local ]; then echo 'Missing .env.production.local.'; exit 1; fi; wrangler dev --env production --env-file ../../.env.production.local
scripts.configure:r2-lifecycle:staging: wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle set coin-archive-staging-surface-images --file ../../infrastructure/r2-surface-image-lifecycle.json --env staging --force
scripts.configure:r2-lifecycle:production: wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle set coin-archive-production-surface-images --file ../../infrastructure/r2-surface-image-lifecycle.json --env production --force
